parameters.formDescription: Fill in your details, choose the position, and upload your CV (PDF).

values.formSubmittedText: Application received ✅ Thank you for applying! We will review your CV and get back to you by email.

parameters.subject: Update on your application
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $('Application Form').first().json.Name }},

Thank you for your interest in the {{ $('Get Jobs').first().json.job_title }} position and for taking the time to apply.

After careful review, we've decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches our current needs.

We will keep your details on file and wish you all the best in your job search.

Best regards,
HR Team

parameters.subject: =Candidate Review ({{ $('Get Jobs').first().json.job_title }}): {{ $('Application Form').first().json.Name }} - Score {{ $('AI Analysis').first().json.output.score }}
Interview Invitation - Congratulations!
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $('Application Form').first().json.Name }},

Congratulations! We were impressed by your profile and would like to invite you for an interview for the {{ $('Get Jobs').first().json.job_title }} position.

Date & Time: {{ $('Pick Interview Slot').first().json.pretty }}
Meeting link: {{ $('Create Interview Event').first().json.hangoutLink || 'Included in the calendar invitation' }}

A calendar invitation has also been sent to you.

Best regards,
HR Team

parameters.subject: =⏰ REMINDER - no decision yet: {{ $('Application Form').first().json.Name }} ({{ $('Get Jobs').first().json.job_title }}) - Score {{ $('AI Analysis').first().json.output.score }}

parameters.sendTo: ={{ [$('Get Jobs').first().json.hr_email, ($('Get Jobs').first().json.escalation_email || $('Get Jobs').first().json.hr_email)].filter((v, i, a) => v && a.indexOf(v) === i).join(',') }}
parameters.subject: =🚨 No decision after 4 days: {{ $('Application Form').first().json.Name }} ({{ $('Get Jobs').first().json.job_title }})
